title: Jude Hill — Web Designer & Developer in Eugene, Oregon
description: Hand-built websites for small businesses, creatives, and product launches. Jude Hill is a freelance web designer and developer in Eugene, Oregon — no templates, no page builders.

blocks.headline: Websites, made simple.
blocks.subheadline: Fast, beautiful sites built one at a time for small businesses, creatives, and anyone with an idea worth shipping — designed in the browser, from Eugene, Oregon.

blocks.tagline: A branding studio with sixteen years of work across food, lifestyle, and consumer brands. A custom portfolio site built to put the studio's own brand work front and center.
Family-run Mexican food since 1990 — restaurants, catering, retail salsa, and recipes that go back generations. A multi-page small business website covering locations, menus, and catering inquiries.
End-of-life planning for families who want their paperwork in order before anything goes wrong. A landing page designed to make a hard topic feel approachable.

items.title: Built from scratch
items.description: No templates or page builders. Every site starts as a blank file, so yours ends up looking like your business — not like everyone else's.

items.title: Here after launch
items.description: The site going live isn't the end. I stick around for updates, tweaks, and new pages as your business changes.

items.title: Fast everywhere
items.description: Lean, hand-written code means pages load instantly — on a laptop, on a phone, on bad Wi-Fi.

blocks.text: I'm a high school student from Eugene, Oregon who handles web design, development, and ongoing maintenance for small businesses and creatives — in Eugene and beyond. I design in the browser, ship every few days, and hand off something you can update yourself. When I'm not shipping code, I'm flying FPV drones, running an Etsy store, and making things in my workshop.
